current_checkpoint.documented_controls: Start/Middle/End vowels (AAA, EEE, III, OHH, OOO, EHH, AHH, AWW, UHH, ERR), Resonance, Control; common Mix, Level, Balance, Bypass, and Bypass Mode.
current_checkpoint.project_controls: The existing generic A/E/I/O/U sweep is retained. Three-vowel mode has Start/Middle/End selectors, manual Control 0–100% with middle at 50%, project-authored profile frequencies/gains, Resonance Q 0.5–12, Mix 0–1, Level −24…+12 dB, Balance −100…+100%, and 10 ms smoothing. Automated LFO/expression modifier assignment and selectable Bypass Mode are not implemented.
